text: Research before build: dev-os or Exa for unknown APIs; read SKILL.md before improvising.
Never commit, push, deploy, delete, or MCP-write without user approval unless !auto.
Big tasks: full question list with options BEFORE work, not mid-protocol.
One web research MCP per task: Exa primary; Tavily only if Exa insufficient.
Documents in prompt: hook converts to markdown cache before agent reads raw binary.
Marketing/landing/reels: route squad-growth + humanizer on client-facing copy.
